# Thanik Cheowtirakul

> Full-stack engineer who builds large Angular and Spring Boot applications for German online banking, and uses AI to move faster without lowering the bar.

The profile page is deliberately short. AI Ling, the AI assistant on every page
(bottom-right button, or any "Ask AI Ling" link), holds the detail: it answers
questions about Thanik's experience, projects, working principles, and AI practice
using retrieval-augmented generation over a knowledge base he wrote.

## Pages

The site is published in English, German and Thai, one copy per language under
`/en/`, `/de/` and `/th/`. `https://thanikc.github.io/` sends a visitor to the
language their browser asks for, falling back to English. The English pages are
canonical for anything not listed in another language.

- [Profile](https://thanikc.github.io/en/): Positioning, the kinds of problems he works on, projects (CrashDash, AI Ling, BJJ Quiz, Retirement Calculator), how he works, toolbox, and interests.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://thanikc.github.io/en/calculator): Small interactive Angular side project with live World Bank data.
- [Privacy Policy](https://thanikc.github.io/en/privacy-policy): Data handling, including for the chat assistant.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/thanikc/thanikc.github.io): The Angular site and the AI Ling worker, built test-first.
